summary: Nagase India Pvt. Ltd. offers performance and specialty chemicals tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on sustainable and environmentally friendly solutions. Their products support various applications, including coatings and electronic materials, positioning them as a supplier of materials that meet the evolving needs of the semiconductor market.
